primary: Raw entropy from pooled, ideal-normalized RDFs; no fitting to TI or transport. Each independent replica remains separate.
primary_frames: 1001..2000 inclusive (1000 frames, approximately times 500.5..1000 tau); exclude the initial time-zero endpoint.
half_stationarity: early frames 1..1000 vs late frames 1001..2000; full frames 1..2000
bias_correction: Delete-equal-block jackknife sensitivity; primary block count 20. Report raw and corrected estimates. Validate against independent ideal point ensembles and sample-count convergence, not closeness to TI.
ideal_ensembles: One independent 2001-frame random-point record for every case/replica; same type counts and box; seed 731000+job_index; same pipeline and windows.
physical_label_groups: Merge species sharing q,epsilon,mass,sigma before estimating primary RDF entropy. Retain label-resolved sensitivity.
no_new_MD: Existing trajectories only. Manuscripts remain untouched while this study runs.

resolution_refinement.trigger: Initial B3 mean jackknife-corrected .01 vs .02 bin difference .002752 kB, above .002 practical resolution target. U4 difference .002389 kB. This is a bin-resolution criterion, not a TI comparison.
resolution_refinement.action: All 24 MD and matched ideal controls: extract dr=.0025 to R=3.2 on the 1000 late frames. Combine refined core with original measured dr=.01 outer RDF to R=8.88. Rebin core to .005/.01/.02/.04/.08 and apply identical block checks.
resolution_refinement.reporting: Keep original raw .02 result; report .005-core/.01-tail jackknife sensitivity with .0025-core check. No smoothing, fitted tail, or tuning against TI or D.
